quotes: Law No. (12) of 2020 Concerning Contracts and Warehouse Management in the Government of Dubai
Bid Bond Article (31) a. A Bid must be accompanied by a Bid Bond
The Bid Bond amount will be prescribed by the Government Entity, but must not exceed two percent (2%) of the estimated value of the public tender.
